newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Holiday mood slows sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Holiday mood slows sales.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were lower on Tuesday in very quiet dealings ahead of the New Year's Day holiday, cash grain dealers said.
Dealers noted some movement out of elevators as grain companies raced to deliver against December contracts and balance books before the end of the year.
"We saw a few (rail) cars in here today," one Minneapolis-based trader said. "It's finally starting to move. The railroads were so slow last week."
He said snow and ice had hampered rail movement but warmer, drier weather eased movement Monday and Tuesday.
Several merchants said they anticipated farmer selling to pick up after the first of year. Many farmers had stored new crop supplies last fall to defer tax payments and planned to sell in January.
Most elevators were closing early Tuesday and will remain closed Wednesday in observance of the New Year's Day holiday.
